item.title: Calgary renews programs, awareness as homeless face dire challenges of winter
item.description: The City of Calgary and 20 other partners have started the annual extreme weather response, providing seasonal day spaces and other services for Calgarians who are homeless.

item.title: UNAIDS chief urges Carney to reverse planned global health funding cuts
item.description: The head of the United Nations' HIV/AIDS program is urging Prime Minister Mark Carney to reverse his government's planned cuts in global health funding and foreign aid.

item.title: American ALS patient died alone after paying $84K US in pursuit of healing at controversial Sask. facility
item.description: A 70-year-old American ALS patient came to Saskatchewan chasing the promise of healing offered by the Dr. Goodenowe Restorative Health Center in Moose Jaw, Sask. But former Goodenowe employees say that as her condition worsened, Goodenowe centre management left Susie to fight for her life on her own.

item.title: Couple weds in Nelson, B.C., with little notice — but great support from community
item.description: There is no story that encapsulates the vibes of Nelson, B.C., quite like this. Witnesses, a photographer, an officiant and a musician all showed up at Cottonwood Falls Park, with very little notice, to help an out-of-town couple’s dreams come true.
